summary: Iteration 126 — frontend-only test of the new CategoryRecipePicker (category panels replacing the long native <select>) in Impara (Beginners) and in the Lab plan generator (PianoProduzioneAI). Logged in as admin@mikilab.de (mobile 390x844 + desktop 1920x1080). IMPARA: home-product-recipe-0-trigger is a button; it opens the portal modal home-product-recipe-0-modal showing 5 clickable category panels (cat-basi 6, cat-viennoiserie 32, cat-pane 58, cat-focacce 12, cat-snack 12) each with icon, large bold title and count. Drill-down cat-pane → 58 items (home-product-recipe-0-item-<id>); clicking an item closes the modal and the trigger shows the recipe name; back button returns to the category grid (search input correctly hidden in item view); X closes. SEARCH: typing 'bag' → 3 filtered items, selecting one set the recipe correctly; 'zzzqqq' → 0 items + no-results message. REGRESSION: after picking via the new picker, home-generate created the plan successfully (plan text rendered). LABORATORIO (nav-tab-maestro): capo-product-recipe-0-trigger opens the same modal (5 cats, pane 59 items), selection populates the product (trigger shows name); capo-extra-recipe-0-trigger (after capo-extra-toggle) works identically (focacce → 12 items, selection OK); with qty filled capo-generate became enabled and generated the plan ('Plan generated' + Ciabatta/Step content). No JS console errors from the picker (only pre-login 401s on session endpoints, expected).

issues: The selected recipe name is not clamped: with long names (e.g. 'Artisan Panettone MikiLab — Apricot and Chocolate (Apricot and Chocolate Panettone (sourdough starter, 2 doughs))') the trigger grows from 42px to 82px on desktop and to ~10 wrapped lines on mobile 390px, stretching the product row and pushing qty/day controls out of alignment. Suggest line-clamp-2 / truncate on the span in components/CategoryRecipePicker.jsx line 44.

Recipe count label is hardcoded Italian ('N ricette' / 'ricetta') even with UI language EN/DE (verified in EN: 'Bread & Baked Goods 58 ricette'). Use t()/tri3 like the rest of the component (line 86).
Minor: with 5 categories the 2-column grid leaves one empty cell (cosmetic only).

action_items: i18n: translate the 'N ricette' counter in CategoryRecipePicker (currently Italian in EN/DE).
Clamp/truncate the selected recipe name on the picker trigger to avoid the row stretching on mobile.
critical_code_review_comments: CategoryRecipePicker: search results are limited to slice(0,40) with no 'showing first 40' hint — a user searching a common term may believe results are missing.
Modal has no Escape-key handler and no focus trap / body scroll lock; on mobile the underlying page still scrolls behind the fixed overlay.
byCat is computed for all CATS on every recipes/lang change (fine at ~120 recipes) but recipeCategory() runs 5x per recipe; a single-pass groupBy would be cheaper.
The trigger button has no aria-haspopup/aria-expanded; the modal has no role="dialog"/aria-modal for screen readers.
seed_data_creation: None. Generated 2 throwaway AI plans (Impara + Lab) that were not saved to the archive.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Picker flow: dismiss lab-tour-skip after login. Impara: nav-tab-impara, trigger is immediately in DOM. Lab: nav-tab-maestro — capo-product-recipe-0-trigger is on the Your Lab page after scrolling (maestro-tool-pianoai does not exist as a testid); capo-generate stays disabled until capo-product-qty-0 is filled (hint capo-generate-hint). 'Extra di oggi' pickers only render after clicking capo-extra-toggle. Modal is a portal on document.body with z-[9999]; normal (non-forced) clicks work everywhere.
rca_of_the_issue: No functional defects found; only i18n of the recipe counter and missing text truncation on the trigger.
